sentences.text: Dated this the 30th day of June 2025 The writ petition is filed to quash Ext.P8 stop memo and consider Ext.P9 representation submitted by the petitioner expeditiously.
2. The petitioner is the owner of a fish stall and supermarket functioning in a premises situated within the territorial limits of the 1st respondent - Municipality.
Ext.P3 licence has been issued in favour of the petitioner.
Alleging that the petitioner has carried out unauthorised construction, the respondent has issued Ext.P8 stop memo directing the petitioner to stop the construction of an existing building.
Even though the petitioner has submitted Ext.P9 representation before the respondent on 25.06.2025, the same has not been considered.
The petitioner's apprehends that the respondent may take coercive proceedings pursuant to Ext.P8 stop memo, without considering Ext.P9 representation.
3. Heard; the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondent.

On a consideration of the facts and materials on record, especially that the petitioner has already submitted Ext.P9 representation before the respondent on 25.06.2025 in response to Ext.P8 stop memo issued by the respondent, I dispose of the writ petition by directing the respondent to finalise the proceedings leading to Ext.P8 stop memo, after adverting to Ext.P9 representation and affording the petitioner an opportunity of being heard.
The above exercise shall be carried out in accordance with law and as expeditiously as possible.
Until such such time orders are passed in the above proceedings, all further coercive proceedings as against the petitioner shall stand deferred.
Nonetheless, the petitioner is directed to maintain status quo in respect to the property as on today, till orders are passed in the proceedings.
The writ petition is ordered accordingly.
